literal: Rejoicingly he dwells within my heart always; (yet) 'he dwells having departed, he is a stranger,' says this town.
translation: My beloved dwells forever joyfully within my heart; yet the people of this town gossip that he has abandoned me and is a stranger.
modern: அவர் எப்போதும் என் மனதிற்குள் மகிழ்ச்சியோடு வாழ்கிறார்; ஆனால், இந்த ஊர் மக்கள் அவர் என்னை விட்டுப் பிரிந்து சென்றுவிட்டார், அவர் எனக்கு அந்நியர் என்று சொல்கிறார்கள்.
explanation: The heroine describes the contrast between her inner experience of love and the outer world's perception. Though her lover has physically traveled away, she feels his presence constantly and joyfully inside her heart. However, the townspeople, who can only see his physical absence, gossip that he has deserted her and call him an uncaring stranger. This couplet beautifully highlights how true love transcends physical distance, making the beloved ever-present to the mind.
